title: The quarter blend against ntuple-leaf through the protocol arena
source: Source: analysis/blend_protocol.py over runs cfee89ba-3e06-4549-8cae-c31652464985 (half A) and 2047d413-be8e-4a80-bcea-4c53fbf78619 (half B); seeds 2000 to 2019, four rotations per seed per half, 80 and 80 completed games. Contrasts are candidate minus control in wins per game; the effect is half the per-seed difference of the two halves' slot-0-minus-slot-1 contrasts and the seating term half their sum; 95% normal intervals over seeds.
caption: Each seating alone carries the turn-order term; the corrected effect is the middle point.
